svg.title: Buyer Team Architecture — AWS
svg.desc: Buyer Team architecture on AWS: AWS Step Functions orchestrator (7-node procurement DAG), Strands A2A agents on Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, security & governance layers, platform services, data stores, dynamic system-config, and GitOps delivery.

g.text: AWS Step Functions · Strands A2A · Bedrock AgentCore · Terraform — Hybrid DAG + A2A Topology
Standard Workflow — 7-node procurement DAG · Lambda step-invokers → Strands A2A agents on AgentCore Runtime
